name: FluidInference/FluidAudio
title: FluidAudio runs Pocket TTS and Phonon text-to-speech on the Apple Neural Engine
summary: FluidAudio ported the 18M, 7M and 2M Pocket TTS models and Gradium's Phonon 31M to CoreML with the flow model on the Neural Engine. On an M5 Pro the author reports 24x to 51x real time, about 25 ms to first audio and under 110 MB of memory, so apps can ship fast offline speech on Macs and iPhones.
